messages.content:
List the eight largest moons of Saturn by diameter, largest first. For each
one, output exactly one line in this exact format:

NAME - approximate diameter in kilometers - one distinguishing fact

Output exactly eight lines and nothing else: no heading, no numbering, no
closing remark.

message.content:
Titan - 5149 km - largest moon in the Solar System
Rhea - 1528 km - has a faint ring system and extensive icy cliffs
Iapetus - 1469 km - has a striking two toned surface with a massive equatorial ridge
Dione - 1123 km - features bright wispy ice cliffs on its trailing hemisphere
Tethys - 1076 km - hosts the giant impact crater Odysseus near its south pole
Enceladus - 504 km - erupts water vapor geysers from its south polar tiger stripes
Mimas - 396 km - is nicknamed the Death Star because of its giant Herschel crater
Hyperion - 270 km - is extremely porous and rotates chaotically
